slug: 2026-03-02 Gambia Gov't payments now digitalised live on Yonna Wallet app

GMB.note: Document covers payments to government, not e-procurement.
No consumer-protection rule or redress stated.
Diaspora can pay government fees from abroad but no named corridor is stated.
Document covers payments to government, not to people.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The Yonna Wallet app, run by Yonna Group with over 200 branches and outlets, is live for payments in The Gambia, per The Standard.

Under a partnership with the Accountant General's Department, government fees such as rates, business registration, ID cards and passports can be paid through Yonna Wallet, which the source says is live.
